15d.name: Commenting on posts
15d.status: Full execution window within the 15-day plan; dependent on Custom input detection gate.

steps.text: Implement and verify 'Custom input detection' capability to satisfy the gate requirement (schedulable ~day 1).
Execute commenting workflow on social media posts using the newly enabled custom input detection.

15d.name: Generate daily social media posts
15d.status: Full execution window within the 15-day plan; dependent on Custom input detection gate.

steps.text: Finalize 'Custom input detection' capability to unlock post generation inputs (gate schedulable ~day 1).
Generate and publish daily social media posts leveraging the active custom input detection.

15d.name: Making phone calls
15d.status: Full execution window within the 15-day plan; dependent on Mic access gate.

steps.text: Implement 'Mic access' capability to satisfy the gate requirement (schedulable ~day 1, buffer until day 2).
Execute phone call workflows using the enabled microphone access.

15d.name: Writing valid tenders
15d.status: Full execution window within the 15-day plan; dependent on Camera access gate.

steps.text: Implement 'Camera access' capability to satisfy the gate requirement (schedulable ~day 1, buffer until day 3).

15d.name: Making money (revenue channels live)

steps.text: Implement 'Custom input detection' and 'Camera access' capabilities to satisfy both gate requirements.
Activate revenue channels and process transactions using the enabled input and camera capabilities.

15d.name: Predicting markets
15d.status: Partial execution window; starts day 5 and continues past the 15-day limit.

steps.text: Initialize market prediction models and begin data ingestion on lane researcher.
Refine prediction accuracy and validate outputs; continues to day 20 of the 30-day plan.

15d.name: Positive money income (net > 0) - prep
15d.status: Preparation phase only; actual income realization starts day 19. Must ensure 'Making money' dependency completes by day 12.

steps.text: Ensure 'Custom input detection' and 'Camera access' gates are cleared to support the 'Making money' prerequisite.
Verify that 'Making money (revenue channels live)' executes successfully, as it is a hard gate for positive income.
Audit revenue channel stability and prepare financial reporting infrastructure; actual net-positive income begins day 19 of the 30-day plan.

7d.name: Commenting on posts - gate & execution
7d.status: Gate implementation (Custom input detection) and initial workflow execution.

steps.text: Implement 'Custom input detection' capability to satisfy the gate requirement; verify integration with social media API.
Execute commenting workflow on social media posts using the newly enabled custom input detection; monitor engagement metrics.
Refine comment generation logic based on day 2-5 feedback; continues in the 15-day plan for full window completion.

7d.name: Generate daily social media posts - gate & execution
7d.status: Gate finalization and post generation/publishing cycle.

steps.text: Finalize 'Custom input detection' capability to unlock post generation inputs; ensure stable data feed.
Generate and publish daily social media posts leveraging the active custom input detection; verify content accuracy.
Analyze performance of generated posts; adjust generation parameters for subsequent days; continues in the 15-day plan.

7d.name: Making phone calls - gate & execution
7d.status: Mic access implementation and initial call workflow testing.

steps.text: Implement 'Mic access' capability to satisfy the gate requirement; include buffer for permission handling and hardware verification.
Execute phone call workflows using the enabled microphone access; test voice recognition accuracy and latency; continues in the 15-day plan.

7d.name: Writing valid tenders - gate & execution
7d.status: Camera access implementation and initial document scanning setup.

steps.text: Implement 'Camera access' capability to satisfy the gate requirement; include buffer for calibration and OCR pipeline setup.
Draft initial tender documents using camera-based document scanning/input; validate OCR accuracy against source documents; continues in the 15-day plan.

7d.name: Making money (revenue channels live) - gate & execution
7d.status: Dual-gate implementation and revenue channel activation.

steps.text: Implement 'Custom input detection' and 'Camera access' capabilities to satisfy both gate requirements; verify concurrent operation.
Activate revenue channels and process initial transactions using the enabled input and camera capabilities; monitor transaction success rates; continues in the 15-day plan.

7d.name: Predicting markets - prep & initialization
7d.status: Model initialization and data ingestion start.

steps.text: Initialize market prediction models and begin data ingestion on lane researcher; establish baseline metrics for accuracy tracking; continues in the 15-day plan.

7d.name: Positive money income (net > 0) - prep
7d.status: Dependency verification and financial infrastructure preparation.

steps.text: Ensure 'Custom input detection' and 'Camera access' gates are cleared to support the 'Making money' prerequisite; verify gate status in live state.
Verify that 'Making money (revenue channels live)' executes successfully as a hard gate for positive income; begin auditing revenue channel stability; continues in the 15-day plan.
